title: Ends in ab, with two states that do the same job
notes: q3 behaves exactly like q0: both go to q1 on a and to a non-accepting state on b. One round splits off q1; the next splits nothing, so q0 and q3 merge.
ops: start q0; accept q2; q0 a -> q1; q0 b -> q3; q1 a -> q1; q1 b -> q2; q2 a -> q1; q2 b -> q3; q3 a -> q1; q3 b -> q0
